issues.description: Model loading passes `dtype=` to `from_pretrained` even though the declared Transformers floor expects `torch_dtype=`, risking load failure or ignored dtype.
`generate-stories` tries to read `data/stories/manifest.json` before generating it, so an empty checkout cannot bootstrap story data.
Extraction hard-requires pre-existing story files, but the repository contains no story dataset, making the documented demo path non-reproducible.
Default config is loaded from a repo-root `config.yaml` path that is not packaged with the `emovec` module in a normal install.
Setuptools only includes Python packages and does not declare `config.yaml` as package data, reinforcing the broken non-editable install path.
`load_vectors` does not validate manifest/config/model/shape compatibility, so stale or mismatched vector artifacts can be silently reused.
Story generation uses `urllib.request.urlopen` without a timeout, retry policy, or atomic output handling, so API hangs or partial runs can leave corrupt datasets.
Neutral-corpus PCA materializes all token activations for all layers in memory, which can blow up on larger custom neutral corpora.
Validation records whether the diagonal criterion passed but does not fail the command or return a nonzero status when it fails.
Integration coverage is disabled by default, leaving the real model/data pipeline outside normal test runs.
The end-to-end test depends on the real gated model and missing story data, so it is not a reliable CI smoke test for fresh development.
Generated `outputs/` and `*.egg-info` artifacts are present in the codebase despite being ignored, increasing stale-artifact risk.
